migrations.buyerSteps: Apply it in order: rer deploy applies it to your D1 database, and rer setup or rer dev applies it to a local installation. It adds the agent door's replay aliases and relay tables and an expiry on agent calls, backfilled from each call's own start; no call is rewritten.

agentUpdateInstructions: Back up your data and source changes and exercise a restored copy before adopting. Update to `v0.1.1`, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `rer deploy` with the same environment and input file: it applies migrations 0736_stump_agent_door_relay_upgrade.sql and 0737_stump_business_retired.sql in order. `@runeditrun/rer` moves from 0.2.91 to 0.2.141. `MAIL_PROVIDER` and `MAIL_FROM` are public settings in `deploy.json`, no longer secret bindings; keep `MAIL_API_KEY` as the private mail credential, and set `MAIL_PROVIDER=none` for a Business without mail (then sign in with `rer signin`). When changing the source, keep applied migration files and their order, the ledger's append-only versions, sealed network tokens that no door answers back, the company's agent policy and the door rules D-1 to D-8 in CONTRACT.md. After a contract edit, run node src/base/contract-docs.mjs write, then check, then pnpm run source:lock.
publicReleaseNotes: Stump 0.1.1 makes the first hosted demo possible and brings the release up to Run Edit Run 0.2.141. The demo (demo.run-stump.com) deploys and starts: `deploy.json` declared `MAIL_PROVIDER` and `MAIL_FROM` as secrets beside their public settings, which `rer deploy --demo` refuses, so the two secret bindings are gone and the provider and sender stay public settings; the Run demo workflow now redeploys the demo at each published release. A Business can set Stump up with mail off: `MAIL_PROVIDER=none` leaves email sign-in and invitations unavailable, and the owner signs in with `rer signin` from the deployment checkout (docs/deploy.md). The agent door moves to the 0.2.134 runtime: replay and erasure custody, the Business relay, and value-free tombstones of erased people, with migrations 0736_stump_agent_door_relay_upgrade.sql and 0737_stump_business_retired.sql. No contract clause changes status. Upgrading from 0.1.0: back up, update to v0.1.1, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile and deploy with the same environment; the two migrations apply in order.
